turns.q: Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
turns.replyTail: n Customer Experience Team: Yes — here are the main things a beginner needs to get started: 1. Take your Alen out of the box and remove all protective films. 2. Open your front panel to unwrap your filter (your filter is already inside your unit). 3. Place your Alen along your room's longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture. 4. Plug in your Alen and press the button to turn it on. 5. Leave your Alen running 24/7 for best results. If you’d like, you can follow the full setup flow here
